name: Schweiz / Suisse / Svizzera / Svizra

geography.notes: Use dated BFS municipality numbers and canton relationships, preserve mergers and multilingual place aliases (e.g. Biel/Bienne). Alpine valleys, small rural Gemeinden, Ticino, Romandie and Romansh-speaking Graubünden need explicit strata. Border and enclave claims, including Liechtenstein appearing in trade networks, require actual POS/market evidence; CH does not follow .ch, German language or Swiss currency automatically.

strategies.notes: Evaluate bounded queries or an admitted local extract of the open LINDAS identification subset. Retain legal entity IDs and registered seat separately; active legal status is not active retail, a POS or digital stock. A free/open description does not remove local quotas and resource budgets.
Other API access is a separately restricted surface requiring FCRO coordination. Do not inherit permission from the open subset or send requests for credentials; this route stays pending.

Plan each supplied municipality plus valley/locality aliases; licensed local OSM POIs can provide independently recorded leads. No public Nominatim systematic lookup. Avoid interpreting an alpine locality with no result as a seller-free area.

Use canton/section routes and preserve the same membership identity across languages. Regional sections can cross CH/LI, so verify each outlet. Independent nonmembers and workshop-only members require separate evidence.

Inspect public postcode/member list links for motorised inventory. Keep importers, accessories, rental-only and caravan-only operators as distinct uncertain candidates; membership is not a retail-stock census.
Resolve dealer and service outlets across national language routes. Toyota is one starter network; do not attribute another vehicle class or marque without a verified surface.

Record multilingual seller referrals and branch candidates with evidence. AutoScout24 and MotoScout24 share an evidence group; distinct accounts or locales are not independent legal identities or population samples.

Motorcycle-specific portal retained independently of automobile category parsing. Exclude out-of-scope category-L assets only after evidence; professional accounts do not automatically create physical POS.

Rotate four language/locality spellings, including small Alpine and Ticino garages, with no rating/stock threshold. Public directory entries are leads; current selling activity and location require direct evidence.

Authored queries find hosted stock and micro garages. Use historical URL index only for known candidate domains, without broad TLD harvesting or paid analytics. Swiss spelling and locality language variants do not identify market country.
Manual public business-page referrals complement tiny and web-less sellers. No social scraping, account creation or login-wall bypass; suspected seller/location claims remain unverified.

sources.title: OSMF public Nominatim usage policy
sources.access_notes: Public Nominatim forbids systematic locality/grid/all-POI queries. It is not an exhaustive discovery backend.

sources.title: Common Crawl URL index
sources.access_notes: Free URL archive index, not full-text search. Bound exact-domain lookups; bulk filtering belongs on local index data with resource budget. Archive results are historical leads.

sources.title: Meta explanation of automated collection restrictions
sources.access_notes: Prior permission is required for automated collection. This channel is manual public business-page lead review only, without account creation or login bypass.

blind_spots: Zefix open identification data cover registered active legal entities, not all sole traders, selling establishments or digital stock; other API permissions stay separate.
BFS municipality history and multilingual aliases are necessary for merged communes, Alpine valleys and sparse localities.
Romansh query terms are an authored starter set requiring native review; Italian/Ticino and French/Romandie coverage cannot be inferred from German searches.
Swiss trade networks can include Liechtenstein or cross-border firms; verify each POS and claimed market rather than assuming national membership.
AutoScout24/MotoScout24 share correlated provider evidence; directories/OEMs/member networks omit nonmembers and online-only sellers.
One-vehicle, unknown-stock and home/appointment-only professional sellers stay eligible; lack of a directory row is not absence evidence.
